ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous black peripheral banding along the trailing and lateral edges; a central vertical black streak originating at the median notch; symmetrical tan-pigmented patches located in the central portion of both lobes; scattered black focal spots primarily in the distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 50-degree interior angle and significant vertical depth relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary with variable pixel amplitude; notable jaggedness and pixel-level variation near the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge leading to pointed, upward-tilted lateral terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, high-contrast white pixel clusters representing calcified growth located at both the left and right fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple sets of parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on both lobes, most notably a series of distinct diagonal lines on the right lobe inner surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake marks across the ventral surface and heavy textured growth on the distal edges.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive bifurcated black pigment pattern extending from the central notch downward towards the submerged peduncle area.
